### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                                                                  |
| ----- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| ~     | *n.*   | exit, putting out, output, expelling, emission, throwing out, rejection  |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to exit, leave (intr.), to expel, throw out, emit, put out, reject (tr.) |
| ~a    | *psv.* | gone out, output, expelled, thrown out, emitted, rejected                |
### Synonyms
- [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Quantity/ksen\|ksen]] (throwing *away*, not *out*)
- [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Actions/jen\|jen]] (transmitting, not emitting)
### Etymology
#### Glyph
[[Sen'fi/Glossary/Spatial concepts/on\|on]] with an object. Related to 出.
#### Sound
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Spatial concepts/on\|on]]
- *a priori:* j=interactive/sudden, on=outer
